data.narrative:
Havoc AI is a Series A-stage frontier technology company operating in the ocean and maritime sector. The company has raised $200M to date. The comparable universe is limited, consisting of two private peers—Seasats and Bedrock Ocean—with no relevant public comparables identified in the sector.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which is applicable given Havoc AI's clear Series A positioning. Using total capital raised of $200M as a baseline proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement, the method implies a valuation of $400M. This multiplier reflects historical pricing patterns as companies transition from Series A to later funding rounds.

The triangulated analysis, constrained by limited comparable data and a single applicable methodology, supports a valuation range of $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $400M. Key uncertainties include the scarcity of both public and private comparables in the ocean and maritime technology space, which limits the ability to anchor valuation through market multiples or peer benchmarking. The reliance on a single method introduces material sensitivity to the assumed step-up multiplier. Additional data on peer financing rounds, revenue metrics, and capital efficiency would strengthen conviction in this range.
